Label: Event date
Derivation: Earliest ASTDT of a treatment-emergent event with DERMFL = Y

Label: Censoring date
Derivation: TRTEDT + 30 days (end of the treatment-emergent window); if TRTEDT is missing, EOSDT

Label: Censoring date description
Derivation: LAST DOSE + 30 DAYS, or END OF STUDY (NO LAST DOSE DATE)

Label: Analysis value (days)
Derivation: Event day if EVNTDT <= CNSDT, otherwise censoring day; day of first dose = 1

Label: Planned treatment for the analysis
Derivation: Factor with Placebo as reference level
